4090.src: ada_wp (Peak BF16 Tensor TFLOPS w/ FP32 accumulate 165.2/330.4)

spec_ratio_vs_4090.formula: ratio = spec(GPU) / spec(RTX 4090); 1 GPU-h on GPU ~= ratio 4090-h (optimistic for a 24 GB card)

full_ft_weights_grads_adam_GB_before_act.formula: params x 16 B (ZeRO paper, mixed-precision Adam); ZeRO-2 over 2 GPUs: 2 B + (2+12)/2 B per param per GPU
full_ft_weights_grads_adam_GB_before_act.note: 24 GB card: full fine-tune of any of the three needs sharding + CPU optimizer offload or LoRA; the 14/25-frame 576x1024 whole-UNet fit is UNMEASURED here (the project's whole-UNet runs used 2-frame chunks).

svd_unet_train_s_per_sample_4090.formula: k x t_fwd(14 frames, 576x1024), k = 3 (fwd+bwd) .. 4 (+recompute); 25 frames scaled linearly
svd_unet_train_s_per_sample_4090.label: ESTIMATE, compute only: no optimizer/CPU-offload, data loading, eval or failed runs

route1a_anchor_stereocrafter_volume.formula: 26,000 iterations x 8 GPUs x batch 1 (stereocrafter) x train_25f_s / 3600
route1a_anchor_stereocrafter_volume.label: ESTIMATE, lower bound per training run. FLOOR ONLY: this is StereoCrafter's fine-tune volume INSIDE SVD's own latent space (no latent swap); not a latent-swap estimate

route1a_anchor_dcvideogen_volume.formula: (4k head steps + 20k LoRA steps) x batch 32 (dcvideogen, Wan-2.1-1.3B) x train_s_per_sample / 3600
route1a_anchor_dcvideogen_volume.label: ESTIMATE, lower bound per training run; the LATENT-SWAP anchor (their samples are Wan videos, used here only as a step-count anchor). Compute-only k x forward method -- NOT comparable 1:1 with route 2's converted wall time

route2_anchor_stereoworld.formula: 8 GPUs x 11 days x 24 h; x A800->4090 compute ratio (and A100 bandwidth ratio as 2nd bound); /2 GPUs /24
route2_anchor_stereoworld.label: ESTIMATE (spec-ratio conversion of a published wall time); same data volume assumed

route2_stereoworld_naive_vs_reported.formula: 142,520 clips x k (3..4) x 2.4 s / 3600; ratio = converted reported wall time / naive estimate
route2_stereoworld_naive_vs_reported.label: ESTIMATE. Shows that a k x forward compute floor can sit ~an order of magnitude below a real pipeline's wall time (StereoWorld also conditions on the left view, adds a geometry loss, data loading, etc.)

published_costs_in_4090_terms.note: dcvideogen/dcgen adapt 14B/12B models that do not train on 24 GB cards at all; pixartsigma swapped PixArt-alpha's VAE (latent_channels 4, scaling 0.18215: pixartalpha_vae_cfg) for SDXL's VAE (latent_channels 4: sdxl_vae_cfg_local) -> a same-shape swap, not evidence for a 4->16 channel change

route3_measured_decoder_ft.src: decoder_ft RESULTS.txt (2000 steps 5908 s; encode 890 s); failed its dev gate
